decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.33 Consequence-Sensitive Calibration for release.
rationale: Visionary confirms QIF now connects calibration to an explicit organizational loss boundary and explains why errors differ. Builder confirms schema, source package linkage, four deterministic consequence classes, policy-local weight arithmetic, aggregate assessment, examples, authoring guidance, and 16/16 positive plus 735/735 negative checks. Guardian confirms the verifier does not claim monetary harm, objective utility, cross-policy comparability, semantic truth, quality, or action authority; severe false assurance, policy review gaps, insufficient data, and exceeded tolerance route to governance.
recommendation: Release v0.6.33, then develop v0.6.34 Threshold Robustness without automatic threshold optimization.
